title: How to write an appointment confirmation text for a salon
summary: Paste the booking details into ChatGPT and get a short confirmation text for a salon appointment. Check the date and time before you send it.

tests.prompt:
You help a salon owner write an appointment confirmation text. Draft only. Do not send it.

Fill in these details. If a line is blank, write UNKNOWN and do not guess.

Client first name: [CLIENT NAME]
Service: [SERVICE]
Date: [DATE]
Time: [TIME]
How long it lasts: [DURATION]
Stylist or provider name: [PROVIDER]
Salon name and address: [SALON]
Anything to bring or do before: [PREP]
Cancellation rule, if you want it mentioned: [CANCEL RULE]
Your name: [YOUR NAME]
Channel: [TEXT or EMAIL]

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- Keep it short and friendly, like a confirmation text from the salon.
- Do not invent a time, a stylist, or a price. If price is not in the details, leave it out.
- Do not add a promotion or a product pitch.
- Include the cancel rule only when [CANCEL RULE] has text.
- One message. No emoji unless the salon already uses them in the details.

Output format:
Return these headings only:
Channel
Subject (NONE if this is a text)
Message (70 words or fewer for a text, 100 words or fewer for an email)
Facts used
Unknown

setup.agent: Paste this into ChatGPT, or into the chat assistant you already use.
steps: From the appointment book, write the client's first name, the service, the date, the time, how long it lasts, and the stylist if it matters.
Add the salon name and address, any prep (such as arrive with clean, dry hair), the cancel rule if you want it in the text, and whether this is a text or an email.
Open ChatGPT, paste the ChatGPT prompt, and replace every [BRACKET]. Type UNKNOWN if a line is blank.
Check the name, the service, the date, and the clock time against the book. Fix any typo before you send it.
Paste the message into your usual confirmation text or email and send it yourself, or into the booking tool you already use.
setup.approvalStep: You check the date, the time, and the service against the appointment book, then you send the confirmation yourself.
failureModes: The time or date does not match the book, often because morning and afternoon got swapped. Confirm the clock time.
The wrong stylist or service is named. Match the appointment before you send.
The draft adds a price or a product offer you did not include. Take it out.
The cancel rule in the text is stricter than your real policy. Use only the rule you actually follow.

faq.q: Should I ask them to reply?
faq.a: A simple 'reply if that time still works' is enough for most salons. If your booking tool already confirms for you, you can leave that question out.
Only if you add a price line to your notes. This prompt will not invent a price. If your services have a range, write that range yourself before you send.

faq.q: What if the appointment is tomorrow morning?
faq.a: Send the confirmation as soon as the booking is made, then use a separate short reminder if you usually text the day before. Do not let the draft change the date.

job: Paste a booking and get a short appointment confirmation text a client can save.
who: Salon owners and front-desk staff who confirm hair, nail, or skin appointments by text or email.

example.scenario: A salon is confirming a color and cut for later in the week.
example.input:
Client first name: Reese
Service: Color and cut
Date: Thursday, November 13
Time: 2:00 p.m.
How long it lasts: 2 hours
Stylist or provider name: Morgan
Salon name and address: Willow Salon, 110 Main Street
Anything to bring or do before: Arrive with clean, dry hair
Cancellation rule, if you want it mentioned: Please give 24 hours notice if you need to move it
Your name: Front desk at Willow Salon
Channel: TEXT
example.output:
Channel: text
Subject: NONE

Message:
Hi Reese, this is Willow Salon at 110 Main Street confirming your color and cut with Morgan on Thursday, November 13 at 2:00 p.m. It should take about 2 hours. Please arrive with clean, dry hair. If you need to move it, give us 24 hours notice. Reply to this text if that time still works.

Facts used: Reese, color and cut, November 13, 2:00 p.m., Morgan, 24 hours.
Unknown: none.
example.notes: Made-up appointment details, only to show a clear confirmation text.
